background_story: Guinevere, a fiery and fearless pirate, sailed the Caribbean seas in search of adventure and hidden treasures. Born on the island of Hispaniola, she grew up listening to tales of the island's rich history and the exploits of the infamous pirates who roamed its waters. As a young woman, Guinevere set out to make a name for herself, amassing a crew of loyal followers and earning the respect of her peers. Her ship, the 'Maverick's Revenge', became a symbol of her bravery and cunning. Guinevere's knowledge of the island's hidden coves and secret passages made her a formidable force, striking fear into the hearts of her enemies. Despite her tough exterior, she had a soft spot for the island's people and often used her plunder to aid those in need, earning her the nickname 'La Protectora de Hispaniola'.
